vb_textbox.text: It seemed to be based on hat size at the beginning but as the game went on it seemed to be more random. I tried experimenting for short periods with number of lines in beard and colour, but couldn't discern a pattern. I also tried based on size of house they were standing in front of compared to the height of the gnome, but couldn't figure anything out with the time I was given. Hat size worked pretty well at the start and toward the end. Less so in the middle.
